lines.text: Israel did evil again, so the LORD gave them to the Ammonites for forty years.
The angel told the woman she would bear a Nazirite son who would begin Israel's deliverance.
Manoah prayed, and the angel of God returned to the woman in the field, and Manoah followed her to him.
Manoah offered to prepare a young bull, but the angel said to offer a burnt offering to the LORD.
The angel ascended in the flame, and Manoah's wife later bore Samson, whom the Spirit began to stir at Mahaneh-dan.
